why: a pass record that can go stale is a gate people stop trusting

decision: Six generic stages, not a configurable engine
why: a solo product does not need 33 stages; forks beat configuration

decision: Depth checks are advisory, structural checks block
why: taste is not a gate; a checker that fails on style gets disabled

decision: The game pack attaches checks to existing stages instead of adding stages
why: one lifecycle, domain rules plugged in; a separate game lifecycle would fork the whole tool

decision: The work thread is artifacts, not memory
why: a compacted context cannot recover what was said, only what was written

decision: Prevention belongs in hooks, not in skill descriptions
why: a model under load does the task instead of choosing a tool; only hooks run every time
